category: incorrect early return inside a scanning loop; only the first run of a sequence is ever examined
issue: The compliance check misses long runs of consecutive days whenever the person also worked a shorter block earlier on. Ana is rostered on 4 and 5 March 2024, is off on the 6th and 7th, and is then on every day from 8 to 14 March - seven days straight - but the report says her longest run is 2 days and raises no consecutive-days violation at all. Delete her 4 and 5 March shifts and the very same report correctly says 7 and flags it. Someone whose whole month is one unbroken block is always counted correctly. The rest-period and weekly-hours checks, the clash detection and the coverage numbers are all fine.
